language_task: Pack the cups with a single arm.
outcome_evidence: In base_image, frame 0 shows three cups beside an open cardboard box. Frames 22–43 show the gripper approaching the cups, and frames 44–151 show gradual positioning and closure around the central light-colored cup. At frame 151, the cups remain outside the box; no completed lift, transfer, or packing is visible. Completion is unconfirmed rather than a visibly failed acquisition: the robot does not withdraw empty or visibly drop a cup, and the near-cup movements do not clearly establish a local failure.
